style.backgroundSystem: clean cream white #FFF9F5 for packshots and info shots, soft candy-pink #F7CDD3 for benefit and closing shots, cream party room for scenes
style.iconSystem: simple rounded thin-line icons, one accent color only
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, warm natural window light for scenes
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent candy-pink childrenswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of soft candy-pink #F7CDD3, cream white #FFF9F5, sakura-red accent #D64560 and deep blue #1F3A6E; bright soft studio lighting with a front key and gentle contact shadows; rounded modern sans-serif; simple rounded thin-line icon style in one accent color; clean child-friendly fashion photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set, full silhouette visible
style.surfaceSystem: matte candy-pink board #F7CDD3 and matte cream board #F6EFE6, light fabric drape
